A.quote: When we refer to a stateful instance, we mean an instance that has data on it, which exists only on that instance.

In addition to server replacement, another benefit of stateless applications is that they can scale horizontally because any of the available compute resources (such as EC2 instances and AWS Lambda functions) can service any request.

B.quote: As your needs change, you might find that your Amazon EC2 instance is too big or too small for its workload. If this is the case, you can resize your instance by changing its instance type.
You must stop your instance before you can change its instance type.

C.quote: An *elastic network interface* is a logical networking component in a VPC that represents a virtual network card.

D.quote: Ensure that you plan for downtime while your instance is stopped.
